Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.loggedcontroller

Class LoggedCommandController

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.loggedcontroller.LoggedCommandController
public class LoggedCommandController extends Object
Wraps a LoggedCommandControllerIO (PS5 or Xbox gamepad) to provide AdvantageKit logging of every button, POV, and axis on the controller, plus convenience accessors for binding commands. Each button/POV is exposed as a Trigger suitable for .onTrue(...) / .whileTrue(...) bindings, and each axis is exposed as a plain double getter. Call periodic() once per loop to refresh the underlying inputs and log them.

  • Constructor Details

    • LoggedCommandController

      public LoggedCommandController(String name, LoggedCommandControllerIO io)
      Creates a logged controller wrapping the given IO layer.
      Parameters:
      name - the AdvantageKit log key prefix this controller's inputs are logged under
      io - the hardware-specific IO implementation (e.g. LoggedCommandControllerIOPS5 or LoggedCommandControllerIOXbox) to poll each cycle

  • Method Details

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Polls the controller hardware via io and logs every button, POV, and axis value to AdvantageKit under name. Must be called once per robot loop (e.g. from robotPeriodic()) so that the Triggers and axis getters returned by this class reflect the current controller state.
